name: Pilot / grant starter
plain_use: Prove support, complete site checks, prepare quotes, run launch activities and document the pedestrian movement issue.

name: Starter build
plain_use: Small calisthenics cluster with surfacing, signage and shade basics. Traffic calming would likely remain separate or staged.

name: Happy medium
plain_use: 8-12 station inclusive fitness and wellbeing circuit with access, shade, seating, launch programme, pedestrian-access design allowance, slight 40 km/h zone extension request and potable-water service check.

name: Stretch build
plain_use: Two connected zones with youth challenge, mobility, mind-body space, landscaping, road edge access, traffic-calming investigation and drinking fountain allowance if potable water service can be confirmed.

name: Big dream precinct
plain_use: Whole active recreation precinct; needs detailed design, approvals, traffic treatment confirmation, services confirmation and major co-contribution.
